knimeNode.name: Optimization Loop End
knimeNode.shortDescription: Stops the optimization loop at the NFE budget or configured objective targets.

fullDescription.intro: Feeds the active population and optional DE archive back to Optimization Loop Start for the next pass. The run-wide NFE budget is a strict ceiling: the loop stops before another complete generation when that batch would not fit. Only the active population controls NFE and objective-target stopping. Connect Track Progress's summary output to retain one compact convergence row per run, population, and loop pass.

ports.inPort: Evaluated survivors for the next optimization pass.
Track Progress summary for the current loop pass. Leave disconnected when convergence history is not needed.
Updated DE archive for the next pass. It must use exactly the population schema.
ports.outPort: NFE, best value and stop reason.
All connected progress summaries accumulated across the completed loop.
DE archive retained when optimization finishes.
